title: Present Perfect
subtitle: что сделано к настоящему моменту • результат • опыт

ruleBlocks.text: Present Perfect: что сделано к настоящему моменту
Present Perfect описывает действие, завершенное к настоящему моменту, когда важен результат сейчас. Это время отвечает на вопрос «Что сделано?», а не «Когда именно это произошло?»

ruleBlocks.title: Главный вопрос времени
lines: Present Perfect отвечает на вопрос: «Что уже произошло к настоящему моменту?»
Обычно НЕ отвечаем на вопрос «когда именно?» — это зона Past Simple
Сначала сообщаем результат/новость в Present Perfect, детали времени даём в Past Simple
Сигнал-пара: Have you ever been abroad? (опыт до сейчас) и When did you go there? (конкретный момент)

ruleBlocks.title: Быстрые ассоциации
lines: result now → есть результат сейчас
life experience → опыт (ever/never)
unfinished time → сегодня/на этой неделе/в этом году
recent news → только что/уже/ещё нет (just/already/yet)
for/since → как долго (период + точка)

ruleBlocks.title: Форма на примерах
lines: I have lost my key.
She has not washed the dishes.
Have you learned the poem yet?

ruleBlocks.title: V3 (Past Participle) — третья форма
lines: regular: work → worked, play → played
irregular: go → gone, do → done, see → seen, write → written
Важно: Past Simple = V2 (went), Present Perfect = V3 (gone)

ruleBlocks.caption: Временные маркеры
rows: already, just, yet, still (отрицания), by now
ever, never, before, once/twice/three times, all my life
It is the first time he has cooked breakfast himself; this is the best film I have ever seen
today, this week, this month, this year, so far, up to now, lately, recently, in recent years
for 2 hours, since morning, how long, since when

ruleBlocks.text: Present Perfect используется для действия, которое уже завершилось, но его результат виден или ощущается сейчас. Точное время совершения действия не указывается.

items.en: He has already cleaned his room.
items.ru: Он уже убрал свою комнату, и теперь она чистая.

items.en: I am afraid I have forgotten my password.
items.ru: Боюсь, я забыл пароль, и сейчас не могу войти.

ruleBlocks.title: 6 основных случаев
lines: Результат в настоящем: I’ve lost my keys. (сейчас не могу найти)
Жизненный опыт: Have you ever been abroad? (когда именно — не важно)
Сколько раз / первый раз: She’s been to Rome three times. / It’s the first time I’ve tried diving.
Недавнее действие/новость: They’ve just arrived. / I’ve already done it.
Действие началось в прошлом и продолжается (часто state verbs): I’ve lived here for 10 years.
Незаконченный период времени: I’ve read three books this month. (месяц ещё идёт)

items.en: I've lost my keys.
She has finished her homework.
We have already booked the tickets.
Have you ever been to London?
I have never tried sushi.
They have just arrived.
I haven't seen him yet.
I've lived here for ten years.
items.ru: Я живу здесь уже десять лет.

items.en: She has known him since 2015.
This month I've read three books.
items.ru: В этом месяце я прочитал три книги (месяц ещё не закончился).

items.en: It's the first time I've driven a car.
items.ru: Это первый раз, когда я водил машину.

items.en: How long have you had this phone?
items.ru: Как давно у тебя этот телефон?

ruleBlocks.title: Что важно
lines: Повторяющиеся действия: указываем, сколько раз действие произошло к настоящему моменту
Опыт: They have been to London three times
Первый раз: It is the first time he has cooked breakfast himself
Действия за период: I have drunk two cups of tea today (день еще не закончился)

items.en: They have been to London three times.
items.ru: Они были в Лондоне три раза (опыт до текущего момента).

items.en: It is the first time he has cooked breakfast himself.
I have drunk two cups of tea today.
items.ru: Я выпил две чашки чая сегодня (день ещё не закончился).

items.en: How many countries have they visited in Europe?
items.ru: Сколько стран в Европе они посетили?

ruleBlocks.text: Связь с Past Simple: since (+ Stative Verb)
Часто используем Present Perfect + since, а после since — Past Simple, чтобы показать точку старта действия в прошлом и его связь с настоящим.

ruleBlocks.title: Как работает since
lines: since + точка времени: since 2019, since Monday
since + Past Simple: since they finished school, since I moved here
Со stative verbs (be, know, have, love) обычно Present Perfect, не Continuous
Если важен длительный процесс/активность, чаще используем Present Perfect Continuous

items.en: They have been friends since they finished school.
items.ru: Они дружат с тех пор, как закончили школу.

items.en: That was ten years ago, and things have changed since then.
items.ru: Это было десять лет назад, и с тех пор многое изменилось.

items.en: I have known her since we met at university.
items.ru: Я знаю её с тех пор, как мы познакомились в университете.

ruleBlocks.title: Логика в диалоге
lines: Сначала даём новость/результат в Present Perfect
Потом уточняем, кто/когда/где — уже в Past Simple
Это помогает естественно строить разговор: факт сейчас -> детали в прошлом

items.en: Somebody has spilt water on the floor.
It wasn't me. I didn't do it.
items.ru: Это не я. Я этого не делал.

items.en: The manager has resigned. She announced it yesterday.
items.ru: Менеджер уволилась. Она объявила об этом вчера.

items.en: I've lost my wallet. I left it on the bus this morning.
items.ru: Я потерял кошелёк. Я оставил его в автобусе сегодня утром.

ruleBlocks.title: Длительность
lines: Present Perfect используем для действий/состояний, которые начались в прошлом и продолжаются до настоящего момента
Частые маркеры: for, since, all day, lately, recently, up to now
Особенно это важно со stative verbs, которые обычно не употребляются в Continuous

items.en: I have wanted to try this for ages.
The weather has been fantastic all day long.

ruleBlocks.title: Быстро
lines: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.
I've / you've / we've / they've + V3; he's / she's / it's + V3 (He’s finished.)
yet → обычно в вопросах/отрицаниях; already → чаще в утверждениях
been/gone: He has been to Paris (был и вернулся). He has gone to Paris (уехал и ещё там).

ruleBlocks.title: Ошибки → исправление
lines: Did you ever been abroad? -> Have you ever been abroad?
I have went → I have gone (V3!)
I have seen him yesterday → I saw him yesterday (есть точное прошлое время)
What have you done? (результат до сейчас) vs When did you do it? (точный момент)
He has finished? → Has he finished?
since/for: since 2015 (точка), for 10 years (период)

ruleBlocks.text: Сравнение: Present Perfect vs Past Simple

ruleBlocks.caption: Супер-правило
rows: не называем точное время (ever, already, yet, so far)
часто есть точное время (yesterday, last week, in 2010)
Have you ever been abroad? / Have you seen Anna? (до сейчас)
When did you go abroad? / Did you see Anna yesterday? (в конкретный момент)

items.en: I've lost my wallet. I can't find it.
I lost my wallet yesterday.
Have you seen Anna?
Did you see Anna yesterday?

ruleBlocks.text: Сравнение: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous

ruleBlocks.title: Когда какое?
lines: Present Perfect = факт/результат/количество (что сделано, сколько раз)
Present Perfect Continuous = процесс/длительность (как долго, чем занимался, следы)
state verbs (know, love, belong) → обычно только Present Perfect: I've known him for years.

items.en: I've read three chapters.
I've been reading for an hour.
She has written five emails.
She has been writing emails all morning.

items.prompt: Have you ever flown in a plane?
This week I've had three meetings.

items.prompt: How long have you lived here?

items.prompt: You ____ a pet for three years. (KEEP)
accepted: have kept a pet for three years

items.explain: Вопрос в Present Perfect: Have + subject + V3.

accepted: Who have we forgotten to invite?
Who have we forgotten to invite

items.explain: Отрицание Present Perfect: have not + V3.
I -> have + V3; порядок слов вопроса обязателен.

accepted: What countries have they visited in Europe?
What countries have they visited in Europe

items.prompt: She ____ her phone in a taxi. (LEAVE)

items.explain: She -> has + V3; вопрос начинается с Has.

items.prompt: Что подходит к Present Perfect (unfinished time)?
items.explain: Правильные варианты: this week, so far, today.

items.prompt: Что чаще встречается с Present Perfect для длительности?

items.explain: Соедини маркеры Present Perfect с переводом/смыслом.
Соедини маркеры Present Perfect с переводом/смыслом.

items.prompt: They ____ friends since they ____ school. (be / finish)
items.explain: В главной части — Present Perfect, после since — Past Simple.

items.prompt: I ____ here since I ____ to this city. (live / move)
items.explain: Точка старта после since оформляется Past Simple.

items.prompt: We ____ each other since we ____ at university. (know / meet)
items.explain: know — stative verb, поэтому используем Present Perfect (have known).

items.prompt: Things ____ a lot since that incident ____. (change / happen)
items.explain: Изменение до настоящего -> have changed; момент в прошлом -> happened.

items.prompt: She ____ much happier since she ____ jobs. (be / change)
items.explain: Состояние к настоящему моменту -> has been; событие-старт -> changed.
Это новая новость с результатом сейчас -> Present Perfect.
five minutes ago задаёт точный момент в прошлом -> Past Simple.

items.prompt: The manager ____ . She announced it yesterday.
items.explain: Сначала сообщаем факт-результат к текущему моменту -> has resigned.
yesterday = конкретное прошлое время -> Past Simple.

items.prompt: I ____ my wallet. I can't find it.
items.explain: Есть текущий результат (не могу найти) -> Present Perfect.

items.prompt: I ____ it on the bus this morning.
items.explain: this morning (период уже завершён) -> Past Simple.

items.prompt: They ____ friends since they left school.
items.explain: Состояние, начавшееся в прошлом и актуальное сейчас -> Present Perfect.
in 2012 = точная дата в прошлом -> Past Simple.

Present Perfect: have/has + V3 (результат/опыт до сейчас).

Present Perfect: have/has + V3 (результат/опыт до сейчас).

accepted: We have lived here for 10 years.

items.explain: В отрицании обычно используем yet, а не already.

items.prompt: Why are you tired? I ____ ____ (work) all day.

exercises.title: Photo Set C: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous

items.explain: Длительность активного процесса (for 2 years) -> чаще Present Perfect Continuous.

items.prompt: The birds ____ already ____ to the south.

items.explain: State verb know обычно не ставится в Continuous.
Акцент на длительности процесса -> Present Perfect Continuous.

items.prompt: We ____ a holiday for five years.
items.explain: State verb have (в значении possess/experience) -> Present Perfect.

items.prompt: She ____ at this school for twenty years.
items.explain: Длительная деятельность (teach) -> чаще Present Perfect Continuous.

items.prompt: David ____ in his studio since 10 o'clock.
Mary and Sam ____ stamps for 3 years.
items.explain: Коллекционирование как длительный процесс -> Present Perfect Continuous.
State verb be + существительное -> Present Perfect.

items.prompt: Jack ____ his driving test three times.
Ivan has a stomachache. He ____ junk food all day.
items.explain: Есть следствие сейчас и длительный процесс -> Present Perfect Continuous.

exercises.title: Photo Set D: question builder (PP vs PPC)

items.explain: Видимый результат + недавний процесс -> Present Perfect Continuous question.

accepted: How long have you been waiting for them?
How long have you been waiting for them
items.explain: How long + процесс -> Present Perfect Continuous.

items.prompt: How many glasses of beer (he/drink) today?
accepted: How many glasses of beer has he drunk today?
How many glasses of beer has he drunk today
items.explain: How many + итоговое количество -> Present Perfect.

accepted: Have you ever lived in a tent?
Have you ever lived in a tent

items.explain: Результат к моменту речи -> Present Perfect.

items.prompt: How much money (Kevin/spend) in the casino?
accepted: How much money has Kevin spent in the casino?
How much money has Kevin spent in the casino
Have those vegetables been boiling since 2 o'clock?
Have those vegetables been boiling since 2 o'clock
Have you defrosted the fridge yet?
Have you defrosted the fridge yet
How many messages has she sent today?
How many messages has she sent today
How long has your sister been traveling?
How long has your sister been travelling?
How long has your sister been traveling
How long has your sister been travelling
items.explain: How long + ongoing activity -> Present Perfect Continuous.

items.prompt: How many people (Angela/invite) to her party?
accepted: How many people has Angela invited to her party?
How many people has Angela invited to her party
Have you been sitting here for a long time?
Have you been sitting here for a long time

exercises.title: Photo Set K: Present Perfect form builder

items.explain: already + результат к настоящему -> Present Perfect.

items.prompt: John and Julie ____ (have) their car for about a year.
accepted: John and Julie have had their car for about a year
items.explain: have в значении possession с for + period -> Present Perfect.
yet в отрицании -> Present Perfect negative.

items.prompt: Sue ____ (be) a tour guide since she left university.
items.explain: State verb be + since -> Present Perfect.

items.prompt: (you/ride) into town on your new bike yet?
accepted: Have you ridden into town on your new bike yet?
Have you ridden into town on your new bike yet
items.explain: yet в вопросе -> Present Perfect question.

items.prompt: This new computer ____ (make) my life a lot easier.
We ____ (not/decide) what to get Mark for his birthday yet.
items.explain: yet + отсутствие результата -> Present Perfect negative.

accepted: Has Paul ever met a famous person?
Has Paul ever met a famous person

exercises.title: Photo Set L: Present Perfect vs Past Simple

items.explain: before + опыт до настоящего момента -> Present Perfect.
last night = finished past time -> Past Simple.

items.prompt: Carol and I ____ to the cinema three nights ago.
It's the first time ____ our flat, isn't it?
items.explain: It's the first time + Present Perfect.

items.prompt: They ____ the baby a name yet.
____ to New York when you went to the States last summer?
items.explain: last summer = finished past time -> Past Simple.

items.prompt: I already ____ my homework. Now I can go out.
He was ill last week, but now he ____ .
items.explain: Контраст with now -> важен результат в настоящем (has recovered).

exercises.title: Photo Set M: classroom prompts -> full Present Perfect sentences

accepted: The lesson has not started yet.
items.explain: yet + negative result -> Present Perfect negative.

items.prompt: teacher / already / write / on the board
accepted: The teacher has already written on the board.

items.prompt: Joe and Tim / just / come / into the classroom
accepted: Joe and Tim have just come into the classroom.
items.explain: just + recent action with present relevance -> Present Perfect.

items.prompt: Tony / not / finish / getting books ready
accepted: Tony hasn't finished getting his books ready.
Tony has not finished getting his books ready.
items.explain: Нет готового результата -> Present Perfect negative.

accepted: Christine has already opened her book.
items.explain: already подчеркивает завершенность к текущему моменту.

items.prompt: Dave / drop / pen / on the floor
accepted: Dave has dropped his pen on the floor.
items.explain: Результат виден сейчас в ситуации на картинке.

items.prompt: he / not / pick it up / yet
accepted: He hasn't picked it up yet.
He has not picked it up yet.
items.explain: yet в отрицании показывает, что действие до сих пор не завершено.
